retrieval.selection: SUPPORTS/REFUTES with annotated page IDs; hash-ordered; no shared annotated pages, exact normalized claims or token Jaccard >= 0.8 across selected claims
retrieval.judgment: Binary annotated evidence-page identity only; other returned pages are unjudged, not established irrelevant. Not passage-level judgments or factual accuracy.
retrieval.entityRule: Conservative exact subject-title priority only, corroborated by lead identity; ambiguous title families or disambiguation leads abstain; no date/negation agreement reward
retrieval.adoption: Freeze rule before scoring. Validation MRR and known-page nDCG@3 must not decrease; Recall@6 unchanged; candidate set unchanged. Held-out reported once, no retuning. Reranker remains offline experimental without passage relevance annotations.

nli.selection: Class-balanced, unique normalized premises/pairs/IDs. Exclude previous frozen R1 premise and hypothesis hashes, cross-role exact premises and near-duplicate claim Jaccard >= 0.8. Test premises from all R2 dev excluded. Original source/topic lineage remains unknown.
nli.reason: Independent representative target-domain and supported-language evaluation still required even if numerical gates pass. No automatic production model replacement.
